references.text: The basic formulation of lex talionis (the law of retaliation) with 'eye for eye, tooth for tooth' is first found in the Book of the Covenant in Exodus.
The law of retaliation is repeated in Deuteronomy with the same wording about eye for eye, tooth for tooth, life for life.
An early principle of retribution for harm done to people, where whoever sheds human blood shall have their own blood shed.
Jesus directly quotes this law about 'eye for eye and tooth for tooth' in the Sermon on the Mount and gives a new interpretation that replaces retaliation with non-resistance.
The Lord reserves the right of retribution and vengeance, which places human application of lex talionis in a divine perspective.
